name: io.github.miisodev/handy
description: Native mouse, keyboard, window, clipboard, and screen control for LLMs via stdio MCP.

environmentVariables.name: HANDY_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Master on/off permission toggle (true or false). Overrides ~/.handy/permissions.json when false.

environmentVariables.name: HANDY_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Optional backend override: auto (default), linux-x11, linux-cli, darwin, win32, or virtual.
